title: Jayden Daniels breaks silence on Brandon Aiyuk’s tense 49ers standoff

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jayden Daniels breaks silence on Brandon Aiyuk’s tense 49ers standoff
sources.description: The Brandon Aiyuk saga continues to hover over the 49ers, and now one of his closest football friends is weighing in, even if he insists he has no control over what happens next.
